title: High molecular weight polyethylene via the spatial proximity of benzosuberyl in iminopyridine nickel catalysts
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,31597-31608
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05407A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Areej Khalid, Qaiser Mahmood, Ayesha Razzaq, Yanping Ma, Geng Ren, Yizhou Wang, Tongling Liang, Wen-Hua Sun
Iminopyridine nickel catalysts are typically gave low molecular weight PE. Upon activation with MAO, the prepared nickel complexes exhibited significantly high molecular weights PE of 56–182 kg mol−1 with narrower dispersity of 1.5–1.8.
